posts.title: Ghost Cat
posts.description: In my last post, I wrote about how we got a new kitten and promptly lost it in 12 hours. I'm still absolutely gutted, and feel like an abject failure. Since then, we've rung all the locL vets as well as the animal shelter for the area and made sure the cat's microchip is listed as 'missing'. Hopefully, he turns up.
